what: A unit is rent-restricted if gross rent does not exceed 30 percent of the imputed income limitation applicable to the unit.
how_this_desk: monthly_max = floor(imputed_il * 0.30 / 12). Gross rent = tenant rent + utility allowance.

what: Studio / no separate bedroom: impute 1 individual.
how_this_desk: 0 BR uses the 1-person limit at the elected AMI.

what: 1 or more bedrooms: impute 1.5 individuals per bedroom.
how_this_desk: 1 BR=1.5p midpoint of 1- and 2-person; 2 BR=3p; 3 BR=4.5p midpoint of 4- and 5-person; 4 BR=6p.

what: Imputed income limitation is never less than the limitation for the earliest period the building was in the qualified project.
how_this_desk: Planning flag only. Pass --floor-il with a prior-year 4-person 50% (or any person size) to hold harmless. Not a BIN determination.

what: Income averaging: designated units 20–80% AMI in 10-point steps; average of designated units ≤ 60%; no designated unit > 80%.
column6: 2@80" prints the unit-weighted average and fail/pass.

what: HERA Special 50/60 limits apply only to projects placed in service in 2007 or 2008.
how_this_desk: --hera swaps in HUD HERA_Lim_type26=Special columns. Regular projects must not use them.

what: Rural projects (Housing Act of 1949 §520) may use the greater of area median or national non-metro median.
column5: FY2026 national non-metro 50%) then scales AMI as (ami/50)×that 50% (HUD 120%-of-VLI method).

what: Gross rent includes a utility allowance when the tenant pays utilities.
how_this_desk: Pass --ua. Asking tenant rent + UA is compared to monthly_max.

what: 20-50 minimum set-aside: ≥20% of units at 50% AMI.
40-60 minimum set-aside: ≥40% of units at 60% AMI.
how_this_desk: Eligibility uses the 60% column (published Lim60 = 120% of 50% except HUD rounding).

what: Not an IRS Form 8609 or state HFA determination.
how_this_desk: Offline planning quotes only. Verify against the official HUD USER Excel and the allocating agency.
